templates.description: Teach one coding workflow by moving from promise to CLI proof to takeaway.
avoidWhen: there is no realistic command or output to show

steps.purpose: State the outcome the viewer gets.
Give the viewer a frame for the workflow before details.
Prepare prerequisites, context, and what the viewer should watch for.
Show a realistic command/result sequence, not just one synthetic line.
Explain the underlying mechanism and why the workflow saves time.
Name common mistakes, limits, or when not to use the workflow.
Close with 2-3 actions or memory hooks.

templates.description: Explain an automated agent pipeline with checkpoints and generated artifacts.
avoidWhen: the topic is a single command with no orchestration

steps.purpose: Contrast manual effort with automated execution.
Show the full agent chain before details.
Name each agent by responsibility.
Show what each agent passes to the next agent and where validation happens.
Show the concrete files or outputs generated by the pipeline.
Emphasize that the human approves creative judgment.
Close with the repeatable pattern and next action.

templates.description: Fast vertical ad: product promise, benefits, offer, CTA.
avoidWhen: no price or concrete CTA is available

steps.purpose: Make the product and main benefit clear instantly.
Give 2-3 reasons to continue.
Reveal the price or offer after value is established.
End with one clear action.

templates.description: Vertical ad for products where the pain point is stronger than the offer.
avoidWhen: the user requested a direct price-first ad

steps.purpose: Open with the user problem in product language.
Translate coverages into reassurance.
Add price, offer, or concrete product proof.
Ask for the next step once trust is built.
